name: Maelstrom
author: Erin Carter
description: One vast log-spiral vortex sits centred just off the lower-right corner, its dye arms barely a step brighter than the near-black ground until they tighten and warm toward a glowing core. The whole spiral rotates rigidly and extremely slowly — a full turn takes one to two minutes — while a subtle FBM shimmer drifts along the arms so it never reads frozen.

params.label: Spin speed
params.effect: Angular velocity of the vortex — at min it is nearly still (a full revolution takes minutes), at max it completes a rotation in well under a minute.

params.label: Twist
params.effect: Log-spiral tightness — low gives open sweeping arms, high winds the arms into a dense coil near the core.

params.label: Core radius
params.effect: CSS-pixel radius of the warm bright core region where the palette heats up through its third and fourth colours and the glow pools.
